{{Tabs|History = No}} {{For|[[Humvee 2]]|[[Humvee 3]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Humvee |image-static = DefaultHumvee.png |image-dynamic = HumveeDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Military Base]] |type = Vehicle |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]45s (Level 0)
[[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]35s (Level 1) |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]60 |damage_type = Collision |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]5 |speed = 8 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = No |pvp_spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]40s (Level 0)
[[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]25s (Level 1) |pvp_health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]60 |pvp_damage_type = Collision |pvp_ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]5 |pvp_speed = 8 |pvp_hidden = No |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |pvp_flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Humvee''' ('''High Mobility Multipurpose Wheeled Vehicle''') is the first vehicle that spawns from the [[Military Base]]. It spawns when the [[Military Base]] is at Level 0 or Level 1. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. The '''Humvee''' initially has a spawnrate of 45 seconds, meaning that every 45 seconds, a '''Humvee''' associated with a Level 0 [[Military Base]] will appear. When the associated [[Military Base]] is at Level 1, it has a 35 second spawnrate. The spawnrate is reduced by 5 for Level 0 and by 10 for Level 1 [[Military Base]] in [[PVP]]. There is a limit of three units per [[Military Base]], limiting the amount of '''Humvees''' that can spawn. This however generally should not be an issue, due to how hard it is to reach this limit. ==Appearance== The current version of the '''Humvee''' is a khaki-colored and typical in appearance to other Humvees in real life. It has black windshields, two antennas on the back of the vehicle, black wheels and yellow headlights. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:ClassicHumvee.png|175px]] |[[File:WastelandHumvee.png|175px]] |[[File:CyberHumvee.png|175px]] |[[File:Base1776Humvee.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Premium|Classic}} |{{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} |{{Color|Deluxe|Cyber}} |{{Color|Patriotic|Base 1776}} |- !Obtained From |[[Premium Crate]] |[[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Premium Battle Pass]] |[[Deluxe Crate]] |''🦅 Eagle Screech'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]],
[[Patriotic Crate]] |- ! |[[File:IceCreamHumvee.png|175px]] |[[File:PirateHumvee.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Beach|Ice Cream}} |{{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} |- !Obtained From |[[Beach Crate]] |[[Pirate Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Humvee''' is great for weak enemies that spawn initially during the round, like the [[Normal]], [[Abnormal]], [[Speedy]] or [[Quick]]. **When the [[Slow]] or [[Heavy]] enemies spawn, you should have a more solid defense than just '''Humvees'''. However, multiple '''Humvees''' can be used to defeat these enemies. **When the [[Normal Boss]] or [[Abnormal Boss]] appears, you should be upgrading your [[Military Base]] to Level 2 or Level 3, to spawn [[Humvee 2]]s or [[Humvee 3]]s respectively. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Humvee''' will spawn per Level 0/1 [[Military Base]]. It will go down a random path. *The '''Humvee''' can be useful against [[Hidden]]s and [[Shadow]] if none of your other towers have hidden detection. **The '''Humvee''' cannot collide with [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemies like [[Soul]]s. *The '''Humvee''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Abnormal Boss]]. *The '''Humvee''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and a '''Humvee''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly destroyed. ==Trivia== *The '''Humvee''' is based on the [[wp:Humvee|military vehicle of the same name]] made by AM General, as evidenced by its similar design and same name. *While the '''Humvee''' has a range of 5, it cannot deal any form of damage, aside from collision damage. *Initially, the [[Truck1]] was named the ''Humvee1'' when it was added, even though it was not similar to a Humvee vehicle in any way. **Interestingly, the '''Humvee''' directly replaced both the [[Motorcycle]] and [[Truck1]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''13 October 2019''' -
